schema.name: TR_CertPolicies_NoOverlap
schema.definition:
CREATE TRIGGER certification.TR_CertPolicies_NoOverlap ON certification.RecognitionPolicies AFTER INSERT,UPDATE AS
 BEGIN
   IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM certification.RecognitionPolicies a WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK)
     JOIN certification.RecognitionPolicies b WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) ON a.Id<b.Id
       AND(a.LanguageId=b.LanguageId OR a.CertificateTypeId=b.CertificateTypeId)
       AND a.CohortFrom<=ISNULL(b.CohortTo,2199) AND b.CohortFrom<=ISNULL(a.CohortTo,2199))
     THROW 51301,'CERT_POLICY_OVERLAP',1;
 END

schema.name: TR_CertTypes_SchoolIdentity
schema.definition:
CREATE TRIGGER certification.TR_CertTypes_SchoolIdentity ON certification.CertificateTypes AFTER UPDATE,DELETE AS
 BEGIN
   IF ISNULL(TRY_CONVERT(bit,SESSION_CONTEXT(N'certification.school_catalog_sync')),0)=1 RETURN;
   IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM deleted d LEFT JOIN inserted i ON i.Id=d.Id WHERE d.IsSchoolProvided=1 AND(
     i.Id IS NULL OR i.IsSchoolProvided<>1 OR i.Code<>d.Code OR
     i.DisplayName COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2<>d.DisplayName COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2 OR
     ISNULL(i.LanguageId,0)<>ISNULL(d.LanguageId,0) OR ISNULL(i.SchoolId,0)<>ISNULL(d.SchoolId,0) OR
     ISNULL(i.BaseCertificateTypeId,0)<>ISNULL(d.BaseCertificateTypeId,0) OR
     ISNULL(i.ConversionFlag,255)<>ISNULL(d.ConversionFlag,255) OR
     ISNULL(i.Notes,N'') COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2<>ISNULL(d.Notes,N'') COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2))
     THROW 51501,'CERT_SCHOOL_IDENTITY_LOCKED',1;
 END

CREATE TRIGGER certification.TR_CertFiles_Immutable ON certification.EvidenceFiles AFTER INSERT,UPDATE,DELETE AS
 BEGIN
   SET NOCOUNT ON;
   IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM deleted d JOIN certification.Submissions s ON s.Id=d.SubmissionId WHERE s.Status='submitted')
     OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM inserted i JOIN certification.Submissions s ON s.Id=i.SubmissionId WHERE s.Status='submitted')
     THROW 51302,'CERT_EVIDENCE_IMMUTABLE',1;
 END

schema.name: TR_CertApplications_Transitions
schema.definition:
CREATE TRIGGER certification.TR_CertApplications_Transitions ON certification.Applications AFTER UPDATE AS
 BEGIN
   SET NOCOUNT ON;
   IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM inserted i JOIN deleted d ON d.Id=i.Id WHERE
     i.ActorReference<>d.ActorReference OR i.ActorSource<>d.ActorSource OR i.StudentCode<>d.StudentCode OR i.CohortYear<>d.CohortYear)
     THROW 51302,'CERT_OWNER_IMMUTABLE',1;
   IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM inserted i JOIN deleted d ON d.Id=i.Id WHERE i.Status<>d.Status AND NOT(
     (d.Status IN('uploading','needs_changes') AND i.Status='submitted') OR
     (d.Status='submitted' AND i.Status IN('needs_changes','verified','rejected'))))
     THROW 51302,'CERT_INVALID_TRANSITION',1;
   IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM inserted i JOIN deleted d ON d.Id=i.Id WHERE
     ISNULL(CONVERT(varchar(36),i.CurrentSubmissionId),'')<>ISNULL(CONVERT(varchar(36),d.CurrentSubmissionId),'')
     AND NOT(d.Status IN('uploading','needs_changes') AND i.Status='submitted'))
     THROW 51302,'CERT_INVALID_TRANSITION',1;
   IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM inserted i WHERE i.CurrentSubmissionId IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(
     SELECT 1 FROM certification.Submissions s WHERE s.Id=i.CurrentSubmissionId AND s.ApplicationId=i.Id AND s.Status='submitted'))
     THROW 51302,'CERT_SUBMISSION_NOT_READY',1;
   IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM inserted i WHERE i.Status='submitted' AND EXISTS(
     SELECT 1 FROM certification.Reviews r WHERE r.SubmissionId=i.CurrentSubmissionId))
     THROW 51302,'CERT_INVALID_TRANSITION',1;
   IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM inserted i WHERE i.Status IN('verified','needs_changes','rejected') AND NOT EXISTS(
     SELECT 1 FROM certification.Reviews r WHERE r.SubmissionId=i.CurrentSubmissionId AND r.Decision=i.Status))
     THROW 51302,'CERT_REVIEW_REQUIRED',1;
 END
